knowledge.plain_language_summary: Face-lit channel letters stood off on welded aluminum stanchions from a sectioned aluminum raceway, mounted to an existing building ledge; Principal LEDs and supplies, removable access hatches.
knowledge.rationale: Stanchions raise the letters off the ledge for depth, and the sectioned raceway with hatches keeps the run serviceable.

structure.construction: 0.117in 7328 white acrylic faces, 1in Jewelite trim cap, 4in deep 0.040in returns, 0.063in backs, Principal 12V 5000K LEDs

1.5x1.5x1/8in aluminum angle raceway with 0.090in skin in 3 sections with removable hatches; 2x2x1/8in aluminum stanchions welded to raceway with grommeted LED pass-thru; to existing ledge with 1/4-20x2in stainless screws

craft_observations: Stanchions lift letters off the ledge for depth; sectioned raceway with hatches keeps it serviceable.
